meta.audience: A first-week apprentice on any of the trades this network covers.
meta.why: One habit, proven three times in three different categories, then gated on the competency rather than on attendance.
meta.hostNotes: The host owns nothing in this flow; every node runs in SmartCiti.X. A host that wants a lesson or an assessment in front of it adds an external node and waits for smartcitix:flow.resume.

nodes.title: Pre-brief: protective system in a trench
nodes.why: Read the procedure before touching it — the flipped-classroom brief every station offers, here made the first node so the induction starts with study rather than with a score.

nodes.title: Trench box — protective system
nodes.why: Construction and structural trades: the ground itself is the hazard, and the protective system goes in before an entrant does.

nodes.title: Charge point — isolation and discharge
nodes.why: Energy and power: the same isolate-prove-dead habit, now with stored energy that has to be proven gone rather than assumed.

nodes.title: Valve vault — permit-space entry
nodes.why: Water and environmental: the habit under a permit, where the atmosphere is the thing that is isolated and proven.

nodes.title: Induction gate — isolation and entry discipline
nodes.why: Three clean runs across three categories, or the induction is not complete. The gate reads the same attempt records the certificate claim rests on; it scores nothing of its own.

nodes.title: Induction check-in
nodes.why: The crew's own end-of-block check-in: never scored, never leaves the learner's browser, and the close of the induction rather than a certificate.
